description: Ministry of Ports and Shipping - The Merchant Shipping (Standards of Training Certification and Watchkeeping for Seafarers) Regulations 2016 Published in the Ex.Ord.Gaz. No. 1987/19 of October 04, 2016 is here by amended.
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping under the Merchant Shipping Act, No. 52 of 1971. It specifically amends existing regulations related to training, certification, and watchkeeping standards for seafarers. This content falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and amendments to existing maritime regulations, which are legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
